args.body:
Dear Priya,

I hope this email finds you well.

I am writing to confirm our dinner meeting scheduled for May 24, 2024, at 19:00 at The Gourmet Restaurant. The dinner is planned to discuss future collaboration between our companies.

Please let me know if this time works for you and if there is anything else you would like to add to the agenda.

We look forward to seeing you there!

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
